# Benjamin McKenzie — Company Formation Insights

## About the Author
Benjamin McKenzie is a Startup Mentor based in Hong Kong who helps foreign entrepreneurs navigate company formation, compliance, and business setup in Asia. He studied at the University of Cambridge and has over a decade of experience in venture capital and private equity in Hong Kong.
